name: Lunar Node: Quiet Hours
description:
A research cluster node on the lunar base missed its routine check-in after an unattended shift. Log into the lab host, reconstruct the relevant activity, and recover the concealed evidence. This challenge runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Review ordinary host activity and distinguish incident evidence from routine noise.
